mapper.sql: COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(m.HQ_NM) FROM TB_BRANCH_HQ_MAP m WHERE REPLACE(TRIM(m.BRANCH_NM), ' ', '') = REPLACE(TRIM(()), ' ', '') AND m.USE_YN = 'Y'), v.REGION_NM )
mapper.select:
SELECT v.BLDG_SEQ AS bldgSeq, AS branchNm, v.A0 AS a0, v.A13 AS a13, v.A17 AS a17, v.A19 AS a19, v.A17 AS structureName, v.A19 AS mainUseName, v.REGION_NM AS regionNm, v.DISTRICT_NM AS districtNm, AS addr, v.TOTAL_SCORE AS totalScore, v.TOTAL_GRADE AS totalGrade, v.RISK_CD AS riskCd, v.FACILITY_RISK_SCORE AS facilityRiskScore, v.WEATHER_SCORE AS weatherScore, v.WILDFIRE_SCORE AS wildfireScore, v.COMBINED_SCORE AS combinedScore, v.COMBINED_RISK_CD AS combinedRiskCd, v.COMBINED_GRADE_NM AS combinedGradeNm, v.GRADE_CHANGED_YN AS gradeChangedYn, v.APPLIED_ALERTS AS appliedAlerts FROM VW_RISK_COMBINED v
ORDER BY v.COMBINED_SCORE DESC OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT v.BLDG_SEQ AS bldgSeq, AS branchNm, v.A0 AS a0, v.A13 AS a13, v.REGION_NM AS regionNm, v.DISTRICT_NM AS districtNm, v.REGION_CD AS regionCd, AS addr, v.LON AS lon, v.LAT AS lat, v.BUILD_YEAR AS buildYear, v.BUILD_AGE AS buildAge, v.A24 AS completionDate, v.AGE_GRADE AS ageGrade, v.AGE_SCORE AS ageScore, v.FLOOD_GRADE AS floodGrade, v.FLOOD_SCORE AS floodScore, v.LANDSLIDE_DIST AS landslideDistance, v.LANDSLIDE_GRADE AS landslideGrade, v.LANDSLIDE_SCORE AS landslideScore, v.FIRE_SCORE AS fireScore, v.PREV_FIRE_OCCUR_DATE AS prevFireOccurDate, v.LAND_USE_SCORE AS landUseScore, v.FACILITY_RISK_SCORE AS facilityRiskScore, v.TOTAL_SCORE AS totalScore, v.TOTAL_GRADE AS totalGrade, v.RISK_CD AS riskCd, v.RISK_DATE AS riskDate, v.WEATHER_SCORE AS weatherScore, v.WILDFIRE_SCORE AS wildfireScore, v.APPLIED_ALERTS AS appliedAlerts, v.COMBINED_SCORE AS combinedScore, v.COMBINED_RISK_CD AS combinedRiskCd, v.COMBINED_GRADE_NM AS combinedGradeNm, v.GRADE_CHANGED_YN AS gradeChangedYn, v.ANAL_DATE AS analDate FROM VW_RISK_COMBINED v WHERE v.BLDG_SEQ = #{bldgSeq}

SELECT 'BEFORE' AS totalGrade, v.RISK_CD AS riskCd, COUNT(*) AS bldgCnt FROM VW_RISK_COMBINED v GROUP BY v.RISK_CD UNION ALL SELECT 'AFTER' AS totalGrade, v.COMBINED_RISK_CD AS riskCd, COUNT(*) AS bldgCnt FROM VW_RISK_COMBINED v GROUP BY v.COMBINED_RISK_CD ORDER BY totalGrade, riskCd

SELECT AS branchNm, COUNT(*) AS bldgCnt, ROUND(AVG(v.COMBINED_SCORE), 2) AS avgCombinedScore, MAX(v.COMBINED_SCORE) AS maxCombinedScore, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeE, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeD, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeC, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeB, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeA, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD IN ('D','E') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangerCnt FROM VW_RISK_COMBINED v GROUP BY ORDER BY dangerCnt DESC

SELECT AS branchNm, COUNT(*) AS bldgCnt, ROUND(AVG(v.TOTAL_SCORE), 2) AS avgTotalScore, ROUND(AVG(v.WEATHER_SCORE), 2) AS avgWeatherScore, ROUND(AVG(v.COMBINED_SCORE), 2) AS avgCombinedScore, MAX(v.COMBINED_SCORE) AS maxCombinedScore, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeE, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeD, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeC, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeB, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeA, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD IN ('D','E') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangerCnt FROM VW_RISK_COMBINED v GROUP BY ORDER BY avgCombinedScore DESC

SELECT v.REGION_NM AS regionNm, COUNT(*) AS bldgCnt, ROUND(AVG(v.TOTAL_SCORE), 2) AS avgTotalScore, ROUND(AVG(v.WEATHER_SCORE), 2) AS avgWeatherScore, ROUND(AVG(v.COMBINED_SCORE), 2) AS avgCombinedScore, MAX(v.COMBINED_SCORE) AS maxCombinedScore, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeE, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeD, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeC, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeB, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeA, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD IN ('D','E') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangerCnt FROM VW_RISK_COMBINED v GROUP BY v.REGION_NM ORDER BY avgCombinedScore DESC

SELECT v.REGION_NM AS regionNm, v.DISTRICT_NM AS districtNm, COUNT(*) AS bldgCnt, ROUND(AVG(v.COMBINED_SCORE), 2) AS avgCombinedScore, MAX(v.COMBINED_SCORE) AS maxCombinedScore, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeE, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeD, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeC, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeB, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gradeA, SUM(CASE WHEN v.COMBINED_RISK_CD IN ('D','E') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangerCnt FROM VW_RISK_COMBINED v GROUP BY v.REGION_NM, v.DISTRICT_NM ORDER BY v.REGION_NM, avgCombinedScore DESC

SELECT v.BLDG_SEQ AS bldgSeq, v.A0 AS a0, v.A13 AS a13, v.REGION_NM AS regionNm, v.DISTRICT_NM AS districtNm, AS addr, v.TOTAL_SCORE AS totalScore, v.WEATHER_SCORE AS weatherScore, v.COMBINED_SCORE AS combinedScore, v.RISK_CD AS riskCd, v.COMBINED_RISK_CD AS combinedRiskCd, v.APPLIED_ALERTS AS appliedAlerts FROM VW_RISK_COMBINED v WHERE v.GRADE_CHANGED_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY v.COMBINED_SCORE DESC

choose.when: SELECT 'GENERAL' AS facilityType, g.HIST_SEQ AS histSeq, g.BLDG_SEQ AS bldgSeq, g.BRANCH_NM AS branchNm, g.ADDR AS addr, g.KEPCO_CUST_NO AS kepcoCustNo, g.CHECK_RESULT AS resultText, g.ORAL_NOTICE_YN AS oralNoticeYn, g.NONCONFORMITY_DETAIL AS failDetail, g.LINE_NO AS lineNo, g.CAPACITY AS capacity, g.CHECK_CYCLE AS checkCycle, g.CONTRACT_TYPE AS contractType, TO_CHAR(g.CHECK_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS checkDt, g.RAW_JSON AS rawJson FROM TB_FACILITY_GENERAL_HIST g WHERE g.HIST_SEQ = #{histSeq}
choose.otherwise: SELECT 'SELF' AS facilityType, s.HIST_SEQ AS histSeq, s.BLDG_SEQ AS bldgSeq, s.BRANCH_NM AS branchNm, s.ADDR AS addr, s.KEPCO_CUST_NO AS kepcoCustNo, s.INSPECTION_RESULT AS resultText, s.FAIL_DETAIL AS failDetail, s.DEFECT_CNT AS defectCnt, s.MOTOR_TYPE AS motorType, TO_CHAR(s.CHECK_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS checkDt, s.RAW_JSON AS rawJson FROM TB_FACILITY_SELF_HIST s WHERE s.HIST_SEQ = #{histSeq}

mapper.sql: SELECT AS "hqNm", AS "branchNm", v.A13 AS "bldgNm", AS "addr", v.TOTAL_SCORE AS "baseScore", v.RISK_CD AS "baseGrade", v.COMBINED_SCORE AS "combinedScore", v.COMBINED_RISK_CD AS "combinedGrade", v.WEATHER_SCORE AS "weatherScore" FROM VW_RISK_COMBINED v
mapper.select: SELECT v.REGION_NM AS regionNm, v.DISTRICT_NM AS districtNm, v.REGION_CD AS regionCd, COUNT(*) AS bldgCnt, ROUND(AVG(v.COMBINED_SCORE), 2) AS avgScore, MAX(v.COMBINED_SCORE) AS maxScore, ROUND(AVG(v.LON), 6) AS centerLon, ROUND(AVG(v.LAT), 6) AS centerLat, CASE WHEN AVG(v.COMBINED_SCORE) >= 40 THEN 'E' WHEN AVG(v.COMBINED_SCORE) >= 30 THEN 'D' WHEN AVG(v.COMBINED_SCORE) >= 20 THEN 'C' WHEN AVG(v.COMBINED_SCORE) >= 10 THEN 'B' ELSE 'A' END AS riskCd, CASE WHEN AVG(v.COMBINED_SCORE) >= 40 THEN 'DANGER' WHEN AVG(v.COMBINED_SCORE) >= 30 THEN 'WARNING' WHEN AVG(v.COMBINED_SCORE) >= 20 THEN 'CAUTION' WHEN AVG(v.COMBINED_SCORE) >= 10 THEN 'INTEREST' ELSE 'SAFE' END AS riskLabel FROM VW_RISK_COMBINED v WHERE GROUP BY v.REGION_NM, v.DISTRICT_NM, v.REGION_CD ORDER BY avgScore DESC
